scene: Across the bridge, a bustling sky hub offers three waiting departures.
picture: A flat side view along a high sky terminal platform. Far left, a sleek pink bullet train waits with open doors. Left, the Pacific Islander player stands with his ukulele facing forward. Centre, a wooden solar-sail junk rests with a lowered boarding ramp. Right, ticket gates blink softly. Far right, a green maglev dragon train waits.
shown: a sleek pink bullet train with open doors on the far left track
a wooden solar-sail junk moored at the centre dock with lowered ramp
a glowing green maglev dragon train waiting patiently at the far right platform
